## Substantive improvements

- Repositioned from generic Angular ownership to independent full-stack visualization and data-product delivery.
- Added differentiated visual artifacts: physical auto-placement, semantic configuration diffs, 64×64 model support and precise diagnostic UIs.
- Restored React, Node, REST and relational PostgreSQL product evidence and highlighted current React workbench experience.

## Unresolved qualification gaps and interview risks

- No direct evidence of production GraphQL, Druid, Iceberg or cloud-finance analytics dashboards.
- No quantified interaction latency or UX improvement, external user counts, or documented partnership with a data-science organization.
- React product experience exists, but much of the most sophisticated visualization delivery used Angular, not React; be ready to transfer this architecture in interviews.

## Hiring-manager assessment

Strong independent visualization and full-stack application experience, with compelling examples of complex interactive systems. More domain transfer is needed for specialized cloud spend/AI cost analytics, SQL analytics platforms and GraphQL ownership.
